result.summary: Found 1 major content issue where a promotional badge displays an invalid -100% discount.

issues.description: The promotional badge on the second card under the 'Popular right now' section displays '-100%', which is an unrealistic and likely broken discount value.
issues.suggestion: Validate discount percentage calculations and cap promotional badge values to valid ranges (e.g., 5% to 70%), or display 'Free' if an item is genuinely 100% off.
